title: Mixed Conditionals: Past Condition Leading to Present Result

sections.title: Connecting Past Actions to Present State
sections.content: When a past counterfactual condition impacts the present, the conditional clause takes the past conditional (*ha... lett volna*), while the main clause takes the present conditional (*most... lennék / tudnám*).

items.spanish: Ha akkor megvetted volna a házat, most nem kellene albérletet fizetned.
items.english: If you had bought the house back then, you wouldn't have to pay rent now.

items.spanish: Ha többet gyakoroltam volna, most sokkal jobban beszélnék magyarul.
items.english: If I had practiced more, I would speak Hungarian much better now.

items.spanish: Ha nem mulasztotta volna el a határidőt, most már a kezében lenne az engedély.
items.english: If he hadn't missed the deadline, the permit would already be in his hands now.
